official: 練馬区行政手続における特定の個人を識別するための番号の利用等に関する法律に基づく個人番号の利用および特定個人情報の提供に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案の内容

name: 庁内で連携する事務と個人情報を追加
summary: 区の条例で定める、番号制度で使う個人情報の扱いを改めます。主務省令と重なる特定個人情報を削り、庁内で連携する事務と特定個人情報を追加します。施行日は公布の日です。
changes: 主務省令と重複する特定個人情報を削る
庁内連携を行う事務を追加する
庁内連携で扱う特定個人情報を追加する
who: 区の行政手続で、特定個人情報が庁内連携される人
why: 法改正に伴う規定の整理と、庁内連携を行う事務および特定個人情報の追加を行うためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds internally coordinated tasks and personal information
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Use of Individual Numbers and the Provision of Specified Personal Information under the Act on the Use of Numbers to Identify Specific Individuals in Administrative Procedures in Nerima City
en.summary: Amends the handling of personal information used under the Number System, as set out in the ward’s ordinance. It removes specified personal information that duplicates information covered by the competent ministerial ordinance, and adds administrative tasks coordinated within the ward and specified personal information. The ordinance takes effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Removes specified personal information that duplicates information in the competent ministerial ordinance
Adds administrative tasks involving coordination within the ward
Adds specified personal information handled through coordination within the ward
who: People whose specified personal information is coordinated within the ward
People whose specified personal information is coordinated within the ward
People whose specified personal information is coordinated within the ward
People whose specified personal information is coordinated within the ward
en.why: The ward says it is making these changes to update the provisions following an amendment to the law and to add administrative tasks and specified personal information for coordination within the ward.
